rawquery.query: SELECT 0 sysversionid, DATE_FORMAT(receiptDate, '%m-%Y') AS month, COALESCE(NULLIF(paymentType, ''), 'Unspecified') AS paymentType, COUNT(*) AS receipts, SUM(paymentAmount) AS total FROM paymentheader WHERE receiptDate >= '$startdate' AND receiptDate < DATE_ADD('$enddate', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(receiptDate, '%m-%Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(paymentType, ''), 'Unspecified') ORDER BY YEAR(receiptDate), MONTH(receiptDate), paymentType
